moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The 2026 FA Community Shield between Premier League winners Arsenal and FA Cup holders Manchester City will be played at Cardiff's Principality Stadium on Sunday, August 16, kicking off at 3 pm, due to pre-planned concerts at Wembley.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosting
angles.copy: Cardiff is buzzing! The Principality Stadium hosts the FA Community Shield this Sunday, as Arsenal take on Manchester City. Who's heading to the capital for the big game? #CommunityShield

angles.name: National Opener
angles.copy: The traditional curtain-raiser for the new football season is almost here! Arsenal face Manchester City in the FA Community Shield this Sunday. Who are you backing?

moments.title: EFL Championship Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 EFL Championship season kicks off this weekend, with the first match between Wolves and Blackburn Rovers on Friday, August 14.

angles.name: New Season Excitement
angles.copy: The wait is over! The EFL Championship season kicks off this Friday. Who's ready for another thrilling year of football? #EFLChampionship

angles.name: Welsh Teams Start
angles.copy: Our Welsh teams are back in action! The EFL Championship begins this weekend. Get ready to cheer on Cardiff City and Wrexham! #WelshFootball

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley
moments.blurb: The Weeknd is performing a series of highly anticipated concerts at Wembley Stadium in London between August 14 and 19.

angles.name: London Concert Buzz
angles.copy: The Weeknd takes over Wembley Stadium next week! Who's got tickets to see Abel Tesfaye live in London? What's your must-hear track?

angles.name: Chart-topper Live
angles.copy: Get ready for The Weeknd! He's bringing his chart-topping hits to Wembley for a series of massive shows starting August 14th. Which song are you hoping to hear?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Top the Charts
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' continues its record-breaking run at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week ending August 7, 2026.

angles.name: Chart Reign
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is holding strong at UK No.1. Has it become one of your all-time favourites?

angles.name: Fender's Success
angles.copy: Sam Fender is still smashing it! 'Rein Me In' with Olivia Dean is a record-breaking chart-topper. What's your favourite Sam Fender track?

moments.title: Ian Anderson's 79th Birthday
moments.blurb: Ian Anderson, the legendary flautist and frontman of Jethro Tull, celebrates his 79th birthday on August 10.

angles.name: Prog Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 79th Birthday to the one and only Ian Anderson! The Jethro Tull legend and his iconic flute have given us so many rock classics. What's your favourite Tull track?

moments.title: Neneh Cherry's 62nd Birthday
moments.blurb: Swedish singer, rapper, and songwriter Neneh Cherry, known for hits like 'Buffalo Stance,' turns 62 on August 10.

angles.name: 80s/90s Icon
angles.copy: Happy 62nd Birthday to the incredible Neneh Cherry! From 'Buffalo Stance' to 'Woman,' she defined an era. What's your favourite Neneh Cherry anthem?

moments.title: Joe Jonas's 37th Birthday
moments.blurb: Joe Jonas, singer from the Jonas Brothers and DNCE, celebrates his 37th birthday on August 15.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 37th Birthday to Joe Jonas! From Jonas Brothers to DNCE, he's given us so many bops. What's your favourite Joe Jonas moment?

moments.title: Mikey Graham's 54th Birthday
moments.blurb: Mikey Graham, member of the iconic Irish boyband Boyzone, turns 54 on August 15.

angles.name: Boyband Legend
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to Boyzone's very own Mikey Graham! What's your go-to Boyzone classic?

moments.title: Belinda Carlisle's 68th Birthday
moments.blurb: Belinda Carlisle, lead singer of The Go-Go's and successful solo artist, turns 68 on August 17.

angles.name: Heaven Is A Place On Earth
angles.copy: It's Belinda Carlisle's 68th Birthday on August 17! From The Go-Go's to 'Heaven Is A Place On Earth', she's a true 80s icon. What's your favourite solo hit?

moments.title: Kevin Rowland's 68th Birthday
moments.blurb: Kevin Rowland, the distinctive frontman of Dexys Midnight Runners, celebrates his 68th birthday on August 17.

angles.name: Dexys Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to Dexys Midnight Runners' legendary frontman, Kevin Rowland, on August 17! 'Come On Eileen' still gets us every time! What's your favourite Dexys track?

moments.title: Aphex Twin's 55th Birthday
moments.blurb: Richard D. James, better known as the influential electronic musician Aphex Twin, turns 55 on August 18.

angles.name: Electronic Pioneer
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to the groundbreaking Aphex Twin, Richard D. James, on August 18! His influence on electronic music is immense. What's your favourite Aphex Twin track?

moments.title: Professor T Series 4 Premieres
moments.blurb: The fourth series of the popular crime drama 'Professor T' is set to premiere on ITV1 and ITVX on Wednesday, August 19, at 9 pm.

angles.name: New Series Alert
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! Professor T Series 4 arrives on ITV1 and ITVX next Wednesday, August 19. Get ready for more intriguing cases and unique insights from the eccentric criminologist.

moments.title: Love Is Blind: UK Season 3
moments.blurb: The third season of the reality dating show 'Love Is Blind: UK' premieres globally on Netflix on Wednesday, August 19.

angles.name: Netflix Dating Show
angles.copy: Is love truly blind? Find out next Wednesday as Love Is Blind: UK Season 3 drops globally on Netflix! Who's ready for more pod drama?
